Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. ONE woman, facing the camera in a frontal view, framed from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Filipina woman, mid 20s, with a fire-sorceress heroine look brought to life, with very long straight hair fading from black at the roots to fiery red-orange at the ends. Her complexion is a warm golden tan, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her lips are full and glossy, in a coral-red gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a daring smile. A deep rose blush spreads over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose and the ears. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded tip with a tiny highlight and a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils barely visible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a softly narrowed anime face shape. A fierce, playful, wide-eyed gaze with a spark of mischief. Her skin, across her face, neck and shoulders, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders and collarbones, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead and collarbones, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. At her neck she wears a real chunky sterling silver cable-chain necklace resting on her collarbones. Background: a softly blurred twilight sky with glowing embers and warm orange bokeh.

Lighting: bright, soft, even light across the face with only gentle shading, and a thin rim light along the hair and shoulders. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/4, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
